name: quantus-research
description: Check a stock-picking idea against real Korean and US market data: backtests over the longest available period, metrics, prices and factors. Read-only - it never places orders.

interface.shortDescription: Backtest stock ideas on real data
interface.longDescription: Sign in to Quantus once, then ask in plain words: backtest a rule like "10 Korean stocks with the lowest PER, rebalanced monthly" over the longest period the data covers, see a company's metrics, or check prices and factors for Korean and US stocks. Read-only: it never places orders, moves money or changes accounts. Past backtest results do not guarantee future returns, and Quantus does not give investment advice.
defaultPrompt: Backtest the 10 Korean stocks with the lowest PER, rebalanced monthly, over the longest period.
Show me Samsung Electronics' PER over the last year.
Which data fields can I use for a US stock backtest?
